Cybercriminals are currently hiding malware inside torrent files for popular films — a reminder to staff to avoid downloading movies or software from unofficial sites, as these files can silently compromise your device and potentially your organisation's network. Separately, the University of Sydney is now offering free ChatGPT Edu access to all its students and staff, which may prompt similar interest across other Australian training organisations.

If your organisation is exploring AI tools, be aware that AI agents can rack up unexpected costs if left unchecked, so ensure any AI access is approved and monitored by your IT team before use.

**Tip:** Never download media files from torrent or unofficial sites — use licensed streaming services only.
